descriptions.notStarted: What is that old man doing over there with all those Graham Crackers?
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with the old man, Mr. Kit Kat, and he wants to build a Graham Cracker house, but the monsters keep eating them...not that I blame them, they look delicious...despite my hunger, I've agreed to get 50 Graham Crackers for him so he can build his dream house.
descriptions.completed: I got all the Graham Cracker pieces (and resisted the temptation to eat them), returned to Mr. Kit Kat and he gave me something tasty?Banana Graham Pie. 2 of them!
